paper_title: Constraints on photon mass and dark photon from the Jovian magnetic field
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter epsilon (dimensionless), exactly as plotted on the y-axis
notes: Paper sets 95% credible Bayesian (Jeffreys prior) upper limits on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon vs mass mX using Juno MAG data of Jupiter's magnetic field. Limit is independent of dark photon relic density (not a DM haloscope), so no local DM density assumed. Explicit numerical values from text: at eps=1 exclusion spans 3.2e-18 eV <= mX <= 3.2e-14 eV; strongest bound eps <= 2.8e-3 at mX = 2.0e-15 eV. Full exclusion contour is in Fig. 7 but only these anchor points are given numerically in the text, so the 3-point contour is a coarse approximation of the actual limit curve.
